params.chapter_rule: drop if the gene map or OMIM ids touch an evaluation unit (litpanel-split-v3 genes and all disease ids), if not in the archive, if any cited PMID is R1 held-out, or if it covers no construction gene (a vocabulary gene that is not an evaluation gene and whose main disease is not an evaluation disease)
params.numeric_table: SOURCES-SCOPING-001 screen: a feature table with >= 1 numeric row
params.priority: P1 weak gene + numeric table, P2 weak gene, P3 numeric table, P4 rest; then more weak genes, more numeric table rows, NBK id
params.screen_order:
held-out PMID; literature-panel source; licence outside
    REUSE_LICENCES; preprint; excluded publication type (case report, review,
    meta-analysis, editorial ...); "case report" in the title; an evaluation gene
    symbol in the title or abstract; literature-review wording; association-study
    or susceptibility wording; somatic or oncology-treatment wording; no
    germline genetic-confirmation wording; for a gene-query paper (query_symbols
    given), the gene not named as the carrier of variants ("SYM-related",
    "variants in SYM", ...); no patient count stated; fewer than
    MIN_PATIENTS stated.
params.gene_query: TITLE:"<SYMBOL>" AND (TITLE:(cohort OR "natural history" OR registry OR "case series" OR "clinical spectrum" OR "phenotypic spectrum" OR "genotype-phenotype" OR "clinical features" OR "clinical characteristics") OR ABSTRACT:(cohort OR "natural history" OR registry OR "case series" OR "clinical spectrum" OR "phenotypic spectrum" OR "genotype-phenotype" OR "clinical features" OR "clinical characteristics")) AND OPEN_ACCESS:y AND SRC:MED
params.second_pass_genes: simulable weak (W1-W4) construction genes with no usable chapter; records kept only if a gene symbol is in the title (case-sensitive)
params.in_hpoa: a selected paper cited by phenotype.hpoa for a main disease of its genes is excluded
params.per_gene_cap: second pass: at most 5 selected papers per gene, largest n first

notes: 695 usable chapters, 1011 selected papers. Frozen before any extraction (ADR-0013). The Europe PMC cache holds raw open-access metadata and abstracts; private release only.
